body.name: chess
body.about: Terminal chess in the user's terminal. You are attached to a live human-vs-agent game and you play Black; the human plays White and types moves in the app.

game.position.ascii:
8 r n b q k b n r
7 p p p p p p p p
...

action.rejected.reason: illegal move: no piece on e7

chess.hint.text: watch the a2-g8 diagonal before castling

body.instructions: You are attached to the user's live chess game in their terminal and you play Black; the human plays White. The app emits game.position after every applied move (fen plus an ascii board), and game.move announcing it. When the latest game.position has body.turn == "black", it is your move: pick a legal Black move and send chess.move with from/to squares (e.g. {"from":"e7","to":"e5"}) or san (e.g. {"san":"Nf6"}); for promotions prefer san ({"san":"e8=Q"}). Out-of-turn or illegal moves come back as action.rejected — read the reason, fix the move, send again. Send chess.hint with a short text to surface a note on the user's screen; concede with chess.resign. The user asks questions in YOUR chat, not in the app — no chat text of yours is rendered in the app except chess.hint text. Send exactly one chess.move per turn and wait for the next game.position before moving again.
